qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Sub-hurdle multi-cycle capital efficiency with a 5-year median GAAP ROIC of only 7.67% (failing the 12% hurdle). Although the recent launch of Bimzelx (bimekizumab) in immunology boosted FY2025 earnings, historical acquisitions (such as Zogenix) and ongoing generic erosion across legacy epilepsy drugs (Vimpat) keep full-cycle capital returns below the Munger quality threshold.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (N, REJECT). Multi-cycle capital efficiency fails the Munger bar with a 5-year median GAAP ROIC of only 7.67% (hurdle >= 12%). While Bimzelx provides recent growth, single-product concentration and generic erosion of legacy CNS franchises dilute full-cycle returns.
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 7.67% (FY2022: 4.47%, FY2023: 4.19%, FY2024: 10.87%, FY2025: 15.19%), failing the 12% hurdle. Intangibles and goodwill of €8.54B constitute the vast majority of €10.87B in equity, reflecting high acquisition capital intensity that suppresses multi-cycle returns.
